source: User supplied yellow-zone A5 terminal summary. Per-process sample summaries, not raw sample files or independent local hardware reproduction.
review_method: Recomputed all four scale gates from72 process summaries with30 samples per A/B case; exact equality with all printed decisions and final crossover.
timer_policy: caller steady_clock before Search through returned CPU Top-K
cpu_policy: Two frozen accepted32thread/32shard binaries; faster median opponent per round and lower p95 per round; six medians all faster and median p95 lower for both A/B.
hardware_pipeline_checks: Log reached all final scale decisions after isolated fused/merge build-install, NPU host compilation, memory probe, raw selector checks, merge checks,8193-tail checks and full checkpoint verifiers. Individual raw check reports remain in yellow-zone results.
unavailable_in_terminal_attachment: full source/installation hashes and raw timing samples
unavailable_fields_location: Existing report.json tiers[].workload, tiers[].memory_plan, device_memory_probe and per-round reports in yellow-zone results; not inferred or fabricated here.

crossover.scope: Only tested article counts, workload and frozen opponents. No interpolation, all-small-scale requirement or MT business-data acceptance.

scope: Measured stable advantage proven at10000000 articles for declared synthetic fixedQ8/three-word/K10 workload against these frozen CPU opponents. No precise interpolated crossover, all-small-scale win, all-large-workload claim, occupancy claim or MT business-data acceptance.
